title: Fare transparency.
bodyText:
A transportation network company's fare structure shall be transparent and visible to a rider before the rider confirms a ride. To satisfy the requirements of this section, a transportation network company shall clearly display:

(1) The fare for the prearranged ride;

(2) The option to receive an estimated fare for the prearranged ride; or

(3) The basis and rate on which the fare is to be calculated, and any additional fees or charges that may apply.

[§279J-4]  Fare transparency.  A transportation network company's fare structure shall be transparent and visible to a rider before the rider confirms a ride.  To satisfy the requirements of this section, a transportation network company shall clearly display:

     (1)  The fare for the prearranged ride;

     (2)  The option to receive an estimated fare for the prearranged ride; or

     (3)  The basis and rate on which the fare is to be calculated, and any additional fees or charges that may apply. [L 2022, c 57, pt of §2]
